GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide and without cover throughout the early stages. Near the 400m blundered and became unbalanced, shifted out and bumped a runner. When questioned regarding the performance rider stated that after blundering and becoming unbalanced rounding the home turn, the mare failed to respond to his riding and was disappointing in the straight. A post-race veterinary examination revealed cardiac arrhythmia for the first time. Trainer was advised of the provisions of the Racing Australia Code of Practice under AR88B(2)(b).  Cleared to race.
